title: The Grand Opening of Twenty Twenty-Seven
skyStory: The year cracks open like a frozen pond at dawn, and the moon is already halfway through its own story, a last quarter lantern hanging in Scorpio. Scorpio does not do resolutions. Scorpio does vows, whispered, with eye contact. Saturn has arrived at the party in a sequinned parka. Mars brought sparklers nobody approved. The moon raises one eyebrow and says: fine, but make it count.

reading: Happy New Year, Tiger. You woke up with twelve resolutions already drafted in your head, and three of them involve a hammer. The [[Knight of Wands]] has read the list and circled exactly one. You know which one. It is the one that made your chest go warm when you thought of it. That is the whole year's compass, right there.

Around 11:40 am, someone will ask what your word for the year is. Do not say a word. Say a sound, like a door creaking open, and watch them laugh. Life Path 3 rule: the first story you tell in a new year sets the tone, so make it a ridiculous one with a happy ending.
joel.mission: Write your one chosen resolution on a scrap of paper, fold it into a tiny tiger, and hide it somewhere you will find it in March.
joel.omen: A neighbour shovelling in pyjamas. It means this year rewards people who show up before they are fully ready.
joel.stoneWhy: Nancy's fire for the first spark

reading: The year opens on your side of the calendar, Mountain. Your solstice birthday was ten days ago, so you have a head start, which you will not mention, because you are classy. The Wood Rat has already noticed who texted at midnight and who texted at 12:07. No judgement. Just data.

This afternoon the [[Six of Swords]] floats by, oars dripping. The crossing from last year into this one is not a leap, it is a row, and you may take it at a steady pace. Tell one story at dinner about the best moment of last year, and let your hands do the heavy lifting. Somebody will tear up a little. It will be a good tear.
nancy.mission: Toast the new year at the water's edge, or the nearest window facing east, and say one sentence out loud to the horizon.
nancy.omen: One perfect boot print at the very top of a snowbank, as if someone summited it at midnight. This month rewards the steady climb.
nancy.stoneWhy: clear and bright, like the first morning
nancy.elementWhy: fresh air for a fresh year

together.text: Send each other one photo of the first sky of 2027, unfiltered, no captions. Then, on a count of three, Joel moves the onyx to his giving wrist and Nancy taps her ruby twice. Equinox and solstice open the year together, and the universe is already grinning.

game.intro: Twenty Twenty-Seven is open for business and the crew already blew a noisemaker in Saturn's ear. Warm up those pipes.
game.prompt: A party popper that misfired at 12:01 and is now quietly embarrassed about it.
